end.summary:
Practised finding tens partners that make 100.
Used tens and jumps on a number line, including 46 to 50 and 80 to 100.
Vihaan explained 70 + 30, 60 + 40, and 80 + 20 using tens.
For 65 to 100, they gave 40 and did not complete the correction.
Teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised making 100 with tens and number-line jumps. Vihaan explained the tens method clearly for 70 + 30, 60 + 40, and 80 + 20, and connected 80 to 100 with two jumps of 10. They mixed up the jump from 65 to 100 by saying 40; this was not corrected before the lesson ended. At home, practise showing 65 to 100 as 65→70 (5), then count the remaining jumps to 100.
